audit.whatIsWrong: The blind is attributed to the wrong two abilities in four fields. The Level 2-3 spike says 'her E Vault knocks you back and applies a blind through her passive Harrier proc'; the late prose says 'her Harrier blind'; wants.foe[0] says Vault will 'blind your follow-up autos via Harrier passive'; whys[3] builds the whole stage around 'Harrier autos'. Blinding Assault (Q) is never named anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Harrier is bonus physical damage on Quinn's first attack against a marked target - no blind in Riot's text. Vault deals damage, slows, briefly interrupts and lands her back near max attack range - no blind either. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q), a separate 1025-range cast on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s that hinders vision. Because it is a cast on its own cooldown rather than a rider on an auto or a dash, it is dodgeable and trackable, which is the whole difference between a lane you can plan and a lane that just happens to you.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault named as the blind, Harrier restored to a damage proc, and Vault's blind removed from all four fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is called a knockback in whys[1], whys[4], the Level 2-3 spike, the Level 6 spike, the early prose, the mid prose and wants.foe[0] - 'knocks you back', 'bait the knockback'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.' She moves, not you. Riven is interrupted where she stands and Quinn ends up 500-odd units away - which changes the response completely. Against a knockback you have been displaced and must re-close from a new position; against this you are still standing on the same spot with Broken Wings charges in hand and only need to cover the distance she just made.
audit.corrected: All seven fields now say Vault interrupts you and leaps her to attack range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Behind Enemy Lines is never mentioned in the content layer, and neither is the fact that a blinded Riven still lands her abilities.
audit.why: Two things the page owes the reader. Behind Enemy Lines is flagged as a channel, so Ki Burst - 11/10/9/8/7s at 260 range - cancels it outright and drops her out of the sky; the quinn__riven mirror states the same interaction from her side. And the blind strips Runic Blade off basic attacks only: Broken Wings and Ki Burst land at full damage through it, so a blinded Riven is not a disarmed one and should keep executing the combo rather than backing off.
audit.corrected: The channel cancel written into the Level 6 spike and the mid prose; the blind's real scope written into whys[3] and the early prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Quinn, Skill, Quinn while the packet chart reads Quinn six times then Skill.
audit.why: The page's own whys agree with the packet: whys[3] ends 'the lane is hers unless she overextends' on a row marked Skill, and whys[6] says 'neither side has a clean structural advantage' on a row marked Quinn. Rows 3 and 6 are simply inverted against their own explanations. The quinn__riven mirror re-proposed rows 3, 5 and 6 as one atomic group to the same values.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid prose states Vault's cooldown as 'roughly 11 seconds unreduced' - the number the entire bait-and-reengage plan runs on.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s. Eleven is the rank 2 value, and by rank 5 it is eight - so the window you are planning around shrinks by a third across the lane rather than staying put. Heightened Senses is also worth a number: 50s at rank 1 falling to 30s, which is why her kite speed is occasional early and constant later.
audit.corrected: Real ranges written into whys[1], whys[2], whys[5], the early prose and the mid prose.

edits.after: Vault interrupts you and leaps her back to attack range on 12s; she has it at level 2 before your full Broken Wings chain exists, so the trade math already favours her.

edits.after: Full kit online but Vault still cuts Broken Wings mid-animation — the only clean all-in at level 3 is Flash into Ki Burst while Vault's 12 seconds run.

edits.after: Blinding Assault strips Runic Blade off your autos while Heightened Senses speeds her out of every trade before Ki Burst connects — the lane is hers unless she overextends.

edits.after: Immortal Shieldbow buys margin to survive a botched engage, but Blinding Assault is down to 9s and Heightened Senses to 30s — she still sets the terms of every exchange.

edits.after: Vault (E) interrupts you and leaps her to max attack range; the blind is Blinding Assault (Q), a separate 1025-range cast — step in before Ki Burst and she resets for free.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your reach and Wind Slash threatens an execute, but Quinn's E still interrupts your Q-chain if she vaults mid-combo — save E-shield to bait the knockback first.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your reach and Wind Slash threatens an execute, but Behind Enemy Lines is a channel — Ki Burst cancels it flat, so hold the stun for the moment she flies.

edits.before: Quinn controls this lane from the first minion. Her passive Harrier marks you randomly and every empowered auto she lands shreds a chunk of your HP before your W stun is even relevant. Your Q at level 1 is a melee dash into a ranged champion with a blind attached — she wins every extended trade by default. Farm at the absolute tip of Q range, keep E available to negate one Harrier proc, and do not burn W trying to catch her unless you have already used her Vault. She will Vault mid your Q1 or Q2, knock you back, and walk out untouched. The only early opening is a level 2 or 3 flash-W catch when her Vault is on cooldown — burn flash to get that first kill rather than chasing the lane itself.
edits.after: Quinn controls this lane from the first minion. Harrier marks you periodically and every empowered auto she lands shreds a chunk of HP before Ki Burst is even relevant. Blinding Assault (Q) reaches 1025 units and strips Runic Blade off your autos — but Broken Wings and Ki Burst land in full through it, so a blinded Riven is not a disarmed one. Farm at the absolute tip of Broken Wings range, hold Valor to eat one Harrier proc, and do not spend the stun chasing her while Vault is up. She will Vault mid Q1 or Q2, interrupt you, and land back at her own attack range untouched. The only early opening is a level 2 or 3 Flash catch inside Vault's 12 seconds — spend Flash on that first kill.

edits.before: At 4-5 you still cannot walk up into her poke without accepting a trade deficit, but your E-shield lets you absorb one Harrier auto and look for the W. The key read is her Vault cooldown — it is roughly 11 seconds unreduced and she almost always uses it reactively when you dash onto her. Bait it with a single Q, let her Vault knock you back, then immediately E back in and W before she repositions. If she respects the bait and does not Vault, you close the gap and the stun-chain lands cleanly. At 6, Blade of the Exile's empowered Q range means she cannot simply run to max range and poke — you can cover the gap faster. Force the level 6 all-in when her Vault is down: E in, Q1, W-stun, Q2-Q3, Wind Slash execute. She has no answer if the Vault is burned.
edits.after: At 4-5 you still cannot walk into her poke without a trade deficit, but Valor's shield absorbs one Harrier auto and buys you the stun. The key read is Vault's cooldown — 12 seconds at rank 1 falling to 8 at rank 5, and she almost always saves it reactively for your dash. Bait it with a single Q, let her interrupt you and land at her attack range, then immediately Valor back in and Ki Burst before she repositions. If she holds it, you close the gap and the chain lands cleanly anyway. At 6, Blade of the Exile's extra range means she cannot just walk out and poke, and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel that Ki Burst cancels outright. Force the all-in with Vault down: Valor in, Q1, stun, Q2-Q3, Wind Slash.

edits.before: Two items in, your Immortal Shieldbow and her completed build roughly offset — the matchup becomes a true skill check on Vault timing versus your combo execution. In side-lane you win the isolated 1v1 if you correctly bait Vault before committing your W, but she will look to avoid the straight 1v1 and roam or skirmish in multi-person fights where her Harrier blind and kite-speed shine. Your win condition late is the same as mid: force fights after Vault is burned, never chase her through open terrain, and use Wind Slash to close out low-HP kills she tries to disengage from with passive move speed.
edits.after: Two items in, your Immortal Shieldbow and her completed build roughly offset — the matchup becomes a true skill check on Vault timing against your combo execution. In side lane you win the isolated 1v1 if you bait Vault before committing Ki Burst, but she will avoid the straight duel and roam or skirmish in group fights where Blinding Assault and Heightened Senses shine. Your win condition late is the same as mid: force fights after Vault is burned, never chase her through open terrain, and use Wind Slash to close out low-HP kills she tries to fly away from.

edits.before: Force Quinn to burn E Vault reactively so you can Q-W-Q combo her without the knockback interrupting your chain
edits.after: Force Quinn to burn Vault reactively so Broken Wings and Ki Burst run without the interrupt breaking the chain

edits.before: Land E Vault mid your Q animation to knock you back, reset the trade, and blind your follow-up autos via Harrier passive

notes: The blind was credited to Vault and to the Harrier passive in four places and Blinding Assault was never named at all - the same class of error as the calibration examples, except here the ability was not renamed, it was deleted and its effect stapled onto two others. Second systemic error: Vault described as a knockback in seven fields when it displaces Quinn, not Riven. The two best unstated facts are that Behind Enemy Lines is a channel an 11-second Ki Burst cancels, and that the blind only strips Runic Blade from basic attacks while Broken Wings and Ki Burst land in full.
